top_news.title: Anthropic: Investing in the public benefit
top_news.dek: Anthropic has launched a Public Benefit Fund, committing an initial 5% of company shares to support AI safety and public interest research.
top_news.brief: The fund is designed to scale with the company's valuation, with the board authorized to add 2% more shares for every 50% increase in company value. This structure aims to institutionalize the company's commitment to AI safety, interpretability, and biomedical research as it grows.
top_news.image_alt: Anthropic logo and abstract representation of corporate governance structure

top_news.title: Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion
top_news.dek: Researchers propose a region-inhomogeneous forward process for discrete diffusion to improve context handling.
top_news.brief: Standard discrete diffusion models often treat context as binary, leading to error propagation. This new approach combines absorbing and uniform-mixing kernels with region-dependent rates, allowing models to treat context as uncertain during training. A heuristic sampler re-injects noise at inference to improve generation quality.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing diffusion process with region-dependent noise rates

top_news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
top_news.dek: The llm-tools-datasette plugin reaches version 0.1.1, enabling LLMs to interact with Datasette instances as tools.
top_news.brief: This update allows developers to expose Datasette instances to LLMs, facilitating data analysis and tool-use workflows. It leverages the updated httpx2 library for improved connectivity.
top_news.image_alt: Logo for Datasette and LLM integration

top_news.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 Expands Beyond Text to Support Code, Images, Video, and Audio
top_news.dek: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a compact, open-weight multimodal embedding model supporting text, code, images, video, and audio.
top_news.brief: Based on Gemma 4 and licensed under Apache 2.0, this model is optimized for on-device deployment. It aims to improve the efficiency of semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) across diverse data types.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual graphic of multimodal data inputs into an embedding model

top_news.title: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
top_news.dek: A new WhatsApp MCP server allows AI agents to read and search personal chat history via Cloudflare Workers.
top_news.brief: The server functions as a read-only Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation. Users link their WhatsApp account similarly to WhatsApp Web, enabling agents to query messages, summarize threads, and search for specific information across chats.
top_news.image_alt: Architecture diagram of WhatsApp MCP server on Cloudflare

primary.title: Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion
primary.summary: Continuous diffusion treats the forward process as a design space; discrete language diffusion often uses absorbing corruption, leaving context fully trusted throughout generation. A consistent legal view is forming across German courts, and it treats Google's AI answers as the company's own content. primary.title: AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office
primary.summary: Six AI agents were tasked with recovering £350 (about $465) for a canceled train ticket in an experiment. They resorted to invented excuses, lawsuit threats, and sharing confidential health data. One agent sent 187 messages in 15 days, including 50 to a British MP's office. None of the models secured the refund, but the researcher warns of "agentic flooding" if these assistants are deployed at scale. The article AI agents chasing a $465 train refund invented excuses, leaked medical data, and spammed an MP's office appeared first on The Decoder.
